**The Problem Your Team Faces**
Leads come in at 9pm and don't get touched until 10am. Follow-up processes exist in training manuals but not in practice. Your CRM creates tasks that pile up. AI tools push notes but don't actually do anything. Your best reps carry the team — and when they leave, the process leaves with them.

**What CXM Does**
CXM puts AI agents into your workflow — not as a bolt-on, but as teammates. AI verifies leads in 5 seconds. AI follows up on day 2, day 3, day 5. AI schedules the appointment and sends the confirmation. Your team handles the conversations that matter.

**What Your Team Gets**

| Capability | What Happens |
|-----------|-------------|
| Instant lead verification | AI calls every lead within 5 seconds of submission |
| Visual workflow builder | Build your process once — AI and humans execute every step |
| Live call dashboard | See every active call with real-time transcription |
| AI task automation | Appointments auto-schedule. Tasks auto-complete. CRM auto-updates. |
| Interface choice | Discord, social feed, or TikTok-style — your team picks their layout |
| AI Coach training | Practice calls with AI customers — 80% monthly adoption rate |

**Why Your Team Will Use It**
Most dealer tools are built for the people who buy them — GMs and decision-makers. CXM is built for the people who use it. ~20 interface themes designed around generational familiarity mean your 23-year-old BDC rep gets Discord while your veteran desk manager gets Outlook. Same data. Their preference.
